name: 90815 · Long Beach, CA
findings: ZIP 90815 (Long Beach) has 324 nonprofit organizations. 203 of them (63%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 191 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (68% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90815 (Long Beach) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
